summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of $750M aggregate principal amount of 6.350% notes due 2033, priced on June 25, 2026, with closing expected June 30, 2026. The notes may be redeemed at par plus a make-whole premium before April 30, 2033. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes or to repay revolving credit facility. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation. The filing confirms no registration under the Securities Act; terms lack a special-situation event like a tender, restructuring, or change of control, so no deal_terms are applicable.
